_comment: Rule Revision 3 §11 timeout benchmark. Same 3 map conditions, both slot arrangements, all 3 pairings, at 250/500/750 ms. The frozen reference solvers were NOT adapted (only their input-reading was ported to public_state.emitters). A round-side counts as a TIMEOUT if that side's runner errorCode is TIMEOUT.

250ms.note: preflight failures too — algorithms exceeded the budget even in the small decoy world
